title: Classic British Lentil Pasties
description: A hearty and comforting British-inspired dish featuring lentil and flaky pastry. Perfect as a snack or light meal.
instructions: Roll out the flaky pastry to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
In a large pan, sauté the onion, carrot, and celery in olive oil until tender.
Add the lentil and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Place the filling mixture onto one half of the pastry, leaving a 1-inch border.
Brush the edges with water and fold the other half over the filling.
Press the edges to seal and use a knife to cut a few slits in the top.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until golden brown.
